```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(ggtext)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(webshot)
library(officer)
library(fontawesome)
library(showtext)

# webshot::install_phantomjs()

dashboard <- read_csv("../data/solano_dashboard.csv") |>
  filter(countyname == "Solano", reportingyear == 2025) |>
  mutate(
    color = as_factor(color),
    color = fct_relevel(color, "0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
    indicator_color = case_when(
      rtype == "S" & color == 0 ~ "#D3D3D3",
      rtype == "S" & color == 1 ~ "#FF6347",
      rtype == "S" & color == 2 ~ "#FFA500",
      rtype == "S" & color == 3 ~ "#FFFF00",
      rtype == "S" & color == 4 ~ "#3CB371",
      rtype == "S" & color == 5 ~ "#1E90FF",
      rtype == "D" & color == 1 ~ "#CD5C5C",
      rtype == "D" & color == 2 ~ "#FFAF70",
      rtype == "D" & color == 3 ~ "#FFFACD",
      rtype == "D" & color == 4 ~ "#90EE90",
      rtype == "D" & color == 5 ~ "#87CEFA",
      .default = "#737373"
    ),
    leaname = if_else(is.na(charter_flag), districtname, schoolname),
    change = if_else(is.na(change), "", paste(change)),
    change_arrow = if_else(
      indicator %in% c("ELA", "Math", "ELPI", "graduation", "college/career"),
      case_match(
        changelevel, # improvement means up
        0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
        1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
        2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
        3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
        4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
        5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
        .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"
      ),
      case_match(
        changelevel, # improvement means down
        0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
        5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
        4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
        3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
        2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
        1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
        .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"
      )
    ),
    indicator = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(indicator),
      "ELA",
      "Math",
      "ELPI",
      "absenteeism",
      "graduation",
      "suspension",
      "college/career",
      "science"
    ),
    leaname = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(leaname),
      "Solano County Office of Education",
      "Benicia Unified",
      "Dixon Unified",
      "Fairfield-Suisun Unified",
      "Travis Unified",
      "Vacaville Unified",
      "Vallejo City Unified",
      "Buckingham Collegiate Charter Academy",
      "Caliber: ChangeMakers Academy",
      "Elite Public",
      "Ernest Kimme Charter Academy",
      "Dixon Montessori Charter",
      "Fairmont Charter Elementary",
      "Griffin Academy High",
      "Kairos Public",
      "Mare Island Technology Academy",
      "MIT Academy",
      "MIT Griffin Academy Middle",
      "Vallejo Charter"
    ),
    lea_anonymous = case_match(
      leaname,
      "Solano County Office of Education" ~ "District A",
      "Benicia Unified" ~ "District B",
      "Dixon Unified" ~ "District C",
      "Fairfield-Suisun Unified" ~ "District D",
      "Travis Unified" ~ "District E",
      "Vacaville Unified" ~ "District F",
      "Vallejo City Unified" ~ "District G",
      "Buckingham Collegiate Charter Academy" ~ "Charter A",
      "Caliber: ChangeMakers Academy" ~ "Charter B",
      "Elite Public" ~ "Charter C",
      "Ernest Kimme Charter Academy" ~ "Charter D",
      "Dixon Montessori Charter" ~ "Charter E",
      "Fairmont Charter Elementary" ~ "Charter F",
      "Griffin Academy High" ~ "Charter G",
      "Kairos Public" ~ "Charter H",
      "Mare Island Technology Academy" ~ "Charter I",
      "MIT Academy" ~ "Charter J",
      "MIT Griffin Academy Middle" ~ "Charter K",
      "Vallejo Charter" ~ "Charter L"
    )
  )

district_geo <- read_sf("../data/Solano_School_District_Areas_2024-25.geojson")
school_geo <- read_sf("../data/Solano_SchoolSites2425.geojson")

district_geo <-
  district_geo |>
  filter(CountyName == "Solano") |>
  rename_with(str_to_lower) |>
  rename(cds = cdscode) |>
  mutate(
    center_point = st_centroid(geometry),
    lng = st_coordinates(center_point)[, 1],
    lat = st_coordinates(center_point)[, 2]
  )

school_geo <-
  school_geo |>
  filter(CountyName == "Solano") |>
  rename_with(str_to_lower) |>
  rename(cds = cdscode)

race_ethnicity_groups = c(
  "Black/African American",
  "All students",
  "Filipino",
  "Hispanic",
  "Multiple Races/Two or more",
  "White",
  "American Indian or Alaska Native",
  "Asian",
  "Pacific Islander"
)

student_program_groups = c(
  "All students",
  "English Learner",
  "Foster Youth",
  "Homeless Youth",
  "Long-Term English Learner",
  "Socioeconomically Disadvantaged",
  "Students with Disabilities"
)

status_colors <- c(
  "grey",
  "tomato",
  "orange",
  "yellow",
  "mediumseagreen",
  "dodgerblue"
)

colors_only <- c("tomato", "orange", "yellow", "mediumseagreen", "dodgerblue")

font_add('fa-solid', 'fonts/fa-solid-900.ttf')

```

# Solano County Dashboard Overview

## Dashboard Colors

![CA Dashboard Performance Colors](CDE%20Colors.png){fig-align="center"}

## District Indicator Colors

```{r}
#| label: district_table
#| echo: FALSE

dashboard |>
  filter(rtype == "D", indicator != "science") |>
  group_by(districtname) |>
  count(color) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = color, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  select(districtname, `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`) |>
  flextable() |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") |>
  add_header_row(colwidths = c(1, 6), values = c("", "Performance Colors")) |>
  align(align = "center", part = "header", i = 1) |>
  bg(bg = "tomato", part = "body", j = "1") |>
  bg(bg = "tomato", part = "header", j = "1", i = 2) |>
  bg(bg = "orange", part = "all", j = "2") |>
  bg(bg = "yellow", part = "all", j = "3") |>
  bg(bg = "mediumseagreen", part = "all", j = "4") |>
  bg(bg = "dodgerblue", part = "all", j = "5") |>
  set_header_labels(
    districtname = "District",
    '0' = "No color",
    '1' = "Red (lowest performance)",
    '2' = "Orange",
    '3' = "Yellow",
    '4' = "Green",
    '5' = "Blue (highest performance)"
  ) |>
  width(width = c(1.3, 1, 1.3, 1, 1, 1, 1.3))

```

```{r}

  bg(bg = "tomato", part = "header", j = "1", i = 2) |>
  bg(bg = "orange", part = "all", j = "2") |>
  bg(bg = "yellow", part = "all", j = "3") |>
  bg(bg = "mediumseagreen", part = "all", j = "4") |>

  set_header_labels(
    schoolname = "Charter",
    '0' = "No color",
    '1' = "Red (lowest performance)",
    '2' = "Orange",
    '3' = "Yellow",
    '4' = "Green",
    '5' = "Blue (highest performance)"
  ) |>
  width(width = c(1.6, 1, 1.3, 1, 1, 1, 1.3))

```

## Counts of Indicator Colors in Solano County Student Groups: Race/Ethnicity

```{r}
#| label: race_ethnicity_chart
#| echo: FALSE

dashboard |>
  filter(
    rtype == "D" | (charter_flag == 'Y' & rtype == "S"),
    color != 0,
    indicator != "science",
    student_group_long %in% race_ethnicity_groups
  ) |>
  mutate(
    color_word = case_match(
      color,
      "1" ~ "Red",
      "2" ~ "Orange",
      "3" ~ "Yellow",
      "4" ~ "Green",
      "5" ~ "Blue",
      .default = ""
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    color_word = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(color_word),
      "Red",
      "Orange",
      "Yellow",
      "Green",
      "Blue"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(student_group_long) |>
  count(color_word) |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = color_word, y = n, fill = color_word)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(y = (n / 2) + 2.5, label = n)) +
  facet_wrap(~student_group_long) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_only, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = "Performance Color",
    y = "Counts of Indicators",
    title = "Count of performance colors assigned to each student race/ethnicity group\nfor all indicators in Solano County LEAs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )


```

## County Wide ELA Performance (All students)

```{r}
#| label: ela_map
#| echo: FALSE
#| column: screen

academic_districts <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(
    rtype == "D",
    student_group_long == "All students",
    indicator == "ELA"
  ) |>
  left_join(district_geo, by = join_by(cds, districtname, countyname)) |>
  st_as_sf()

academic_schools <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(
    rtype == "S",
    student_group_long == "All students",
    indicator == "ELA"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    school_geo,
    by = join_by(cds, districtname, countyname, schoolname)
  ) |>
  st_as_sf()

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolygons(
    data = academic_districts,
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    color = "#999999",
    weight = 2,
    fillColor = ~indicator_color
  ) |>
  # addLabelOnlyMarkers(data = districts_with_colors(),
  #                     lng = ~lng,
  #                     lat = ~lat,
  #                     label = ~districtname,
  #                 labelOptions = labelOptions(permanent = T)) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = academic_schools,
    label = ~schoolname,
    radius = 6,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 1,
    color = ~indicator_color
  )


```

## Long-Term English Learners: Districts

```{r ltel_counts_districts}

el_counts <-
  dashboard |>
  filter(
    rtype == "D" | charter_flag == "Y",
    studentgroup %in% c("ALL", "EL", "LTEL"),
    indicator == "suspension"
  ) |>
  select(leaname, student_group_long, currdenom, rtype) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = student_group_long, values_from = currdenom) |>
  mutate(
    el_percent = paste0(
      round(`English Learner` / `All students` * 100, 2),
      "%"
    ),
    ltel_percent = paste0(
      round(`Long-Term English Learner` / `English Learner` * 100, 2),
      "%"
    )
  )

el_counts |>
  filter(rtype == "D") |>
  select(-rtype) |>
  arrange(leaname) |>
  flextable() |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") |>
  add_footer_row(
    colwidths = c(1, 5),
    values = c(
      "",
      "Values are taken from the denominator of the suspension indicator which is the most inclusive indicator."
    )
  ) |>
  set_header_labels(
    leaname = "LEA",
    `English Learner` = "English Learners",
    `Long-Term English Learner` = "Long-Term English Learners",
    el_percent = "Percent of students that are ELs",
    ltel_percent = "Percent of ELs that are LTELs"
  ) |>
  width(width = c(1.8, 1, 1, 1.2, 1.6, 1.6)) |>
  align(
    align = c("left", "right", "right", "right", "right", "right"),
    part = "all"
  )

```

# Student Group Details

## Detail Key

![](dashboard-cell-key-CDE-change%20CSI.png)

## All Students

```{r all_students}

showtext_auto()

dashboard |>
  filter(
    student_group_long == "All students",
    rtype == "D" | (rtype == "S" & charter_flag == "Y")
  ) |>
  arrange(rtype) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_richtext(
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    mapping = aes(
      label = if_else(
        indicator %in% c("ELA", "Math", "science"),
        paste(currstatus, change_arrow, change),
        paste0(currstatus, "% ", change_arrow, " ", change)
      ),
      fill = color
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    text.color = "black",
    color = "darkgrey",
    label.size = 0.8,
    size = 3.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE, na.value = "white") +
  facet_grid(leaname ~ indicator, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text.y = element_markdown(
      size = 11,
      angle = 0,
      vjust = 0.7,
      hjust = 0
    ),
    strip.clip = "off",
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt")
  )

showtext_auto(FALSE)
```

## Students with disabilities

```{r swd}

showtext_auto()

dashboard |>
  filter(
    student_group_long == "Students with Disabilities",
    rtype == "D" | (rtype == "S" & charter_flag == "Y")
  ) |>
  arrange(rtype) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_richtext(
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    mapping = aes(
      label = if_else(
        indicator %in% c("ELA", "Math", "science"),
        paste(currstatus, change_arrow, change),
        paste0(currstatus, "% ", change_arrow, " ", change)
      ),
      fill = color
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    text.color = "black",
    color = "darkgrey",
    label.size = 0.8,
    size = 3.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE, na.value = "white") +
  facet_grid(leaname ~ indicator, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text.y = element_markdown(
      size = 11,
      angle = 0,
      vjust = 0.7,
      hjust = 0
    ),
    strip.clip = "off",
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt")
  )

showtext_auto(FALSE)
```
